conservative.read: This conservative approach aims for capital preservation with a target of around 1.5% monthly return. It significantly reduces leverage and focuses on stable assets, aiming for lower drawdowns.

balanced.read: This balanced strategy targets around 2.5% monthly return by blending broad market exposure with quality tech and reduced leverage. It prioritizes risk management while seeking growth.
